role: The parsed 'animation' section of a texture's .mcmeta: the frame list, the frame size and the default frame time that TextureAtlasSprite uses to cycle an animated texture.
scope_reason: Metadata consumed as data: RenderStateProbe.animFrames dumps each animated sprite's frametime and frame list (state/anim.json), which csrc/engine/texanim.c (struct texanim_sprite: frametime, index, time) animates; the JSON section itself never runs natively.

members.name: getFrameTimeSingle
members.note: per-frame time or the section default

notes: If a later milestone wants vanilla water/lava/portal animation on the GPU path, this section and its serializer are the Java source of truth for the frame order and timing. idxaudit 2026-09-27: scope reason rewritten.
